title: Street children and beggars in Makassar City: adaptive policies to address urban social problems
core_idea: To understand the dynamics and challenges of street children and beggars in Makassar City from the perspectives of policy implementers and affected communities using a phenomenological approach and qualitative analysis, in order to develop adaptive, locally appropriate policy recommendations.
tldr: The study investigates the phenomenon of street children and beggars in Makassar through phenomenological fieldwork and NVivo-assisted qualitative analysis to inform adaptive, context-sensitive policies for handling this urban social problem.
